notes.title: Update on Our Next Fest Plans
notes.content:
[b]Update on Our Next Fest Plans[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45329302/ac7b5b3b1360141742cc734509e06302d5e05138.png[/img]

Hey everyone,

We’ve made the tough decision to step back from the upcoming Steam Next Fest and instead set our sights on the June edition. Our goal has always been to bring you the best possible experience, and after careful consideration, we feel that a little extra time will allow us to refine the demo and ensure it truly shines.

This wasn’t an easy choice, but we believe it’s the right one. We want every moment you spend in our game to feel great, and this extra polish will help us deliver on that promise.

We appreciate your patience and support—it means the world to us. Stay tuned for more updates as we fine-tune the experience, and we can’t wait to share what we’ve been working on!

Thank you for being part of this journey!

- It Just Joe Games
